attempts.text:
**The window starts on a single persistent gene.** Column 0, `hldE`, is a spine column carried by 100% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls, and the model names it in 99% of genomes with 0.02 bits. Then columns 1 to 2 are variable, and the model names only 63 to 93% there.

**A short spine follows at `yqiK` to `glgS`**, columns 3 to 5, carried by 91 to 95% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 5 to 6% of calls, named in 95 to 96%. Columns 6 to 9 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 45 to 56% of calls, where a second branch of 3 families runs through columns 7 to 9, carried by 11% of chromosomes: pilus assembly, fimbrial biogenesis chaperone and fimbria/pilus outer membrane usher proteins. The model names 75 to 90% there.

**Columns 10 to 24 return to the spine**, `ubiK` and `ribB` then `zupT` to `mdaB`, carried by 95 to 96% of chromosomes, named in 60 to 98%. Column 25 is a fork, `ygiZ` in 75% and `fitA` in 27%, and columns 26 to 29 are spine, `qseC` to `ygiV`, named in 93 to 96%. Columns 30 to 32 mix fork and variable columns, `mqsR`, `mqsA` and `ygiS`, [[toxin-antitoxin pairs and transport]], named in 93 to 97%.

**The long spine runs from `parC` to `gss`**, columns 33 to 59, carried by 90 to 96% of chromosomes, named in 90 to 97%, with the `hyb` genes among them, [[hydrogenase assembly and maturation]]. The model hesitates most at column 59, `gss`, 0.52 bits.

**The last stretch is the most plastic.** Columns 60 to 79 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 54 to 86% of calls, and the model names only 56 to 89%. Its most hesitant columns are 61, `yghT`, 1.14 bits, 62, `yghS`, 1.10 bits, and 60, `pitB`, 1.10 bits. Two branches run here: `speC` to `mutY` through columns 67 to 71, carried by 10 to 13%, and `pppA`, `gspS2` and `gspC` through columns 76 to 78, carried by 10 to 12%. The window ends at column 79, `glcB`, in 42% of chromosomes. Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside, 0.80 against 0.15 bits, and names fewer genes, 75% against 95%.

label: hldE
facts:
WINDOW: the hldE window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor hldE, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 651 to 730 from dnaA. Read in 539 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying hldE once); 43,120 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 89% of genes, 0.33 bits on average (perplexity 1.6 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 27,733 calls, named 96%, 0.14 bits; shell 15,061 calls, named 79%, 0.60 bits; cloud 326 calls, named 20%, 3.64 bits. Outside an RGP 31,087 calls, named 95%, 0.15 bits; inside an RGP 12,033 calls, named 75%, 0.80 bits. Columns: 49 spine, 17 fork, 14 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.80 against 0.15 bits) and names fewer genes (75% against 95%); 12,033 of the 43,120 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 61 (yghT) 1.14 bits, RGP 63%; column 62 (yghS) 1.10 bits, RGP 69%; column 60 (pitB) 1.10 bits, RGP 54%. The 23 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 80%, 0.65 bits on average; the other 57 columns: named 93%, 0.20 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 60-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 54-86%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: hldE. named 99%; 0.02 bits.
2. columns 1-2 (2 columns) variable: RGP 5%. named 63-93% (mean 78%), fewest named at column 1, named 63%; most hesitant at column 2, 0.35 bits.
   1: ibsE S 54% "type I toxin-antitoxin system Ibs f…"
   2: ibsE P 84%
3. columns 3-5 (3 columns) spine: share 91-95%, 2 P, 1 S, RGP 5-6%. Genes: yqiK "flotillin family protein", yqiJ "OB-fold-containig protein", glgS. named 95-96% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 3 (yqiK), named 95%, 0.39 bits.
4. columns 6-9 (4 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 45-56%. named 75-90% (mean 83%), fewest named at column 7, named 75%; most hesitant at column 8, 0.94 bits.
   a second branch of 3 families through columns 7-9, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 11%, all S; the branch's families: "pilus assembly protein", "fimbrial biogenesis chaperone", "fimbria/pilus outer membrane usher prot…"
   6 variable: yqiI S 51%
   7 fork: yqiH S 48% "fimbrial biogenesis chaperone"
   8 fork: "FimD/PapC C-terminal domain-containing…" S 46%
   9 fork: ygiL S 56% "fimbrial-like protein"
5. columns 10-11 (2 columns) spine: share 95-96%, all P, RGP 12-15%. Genes: ubiK, ribB. named 82-84% (mean 83%), fewest named at column 11 (ribB), named 82%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.18 bits (column 10 (ubiK)).
6. column 12 variable: RGP 3%. named 95%; 0.08 bits.
   12: yqiD S 84% "protein YqiD"
7. columns 13-24 (12 columns) spine: share 95-96%, all P, RGP 0.2-22%. Genes: zupT, ygiD "4,5-DOPA dioxygenase extradiol", ygiC "glutathionylspermidine synthase fam…", ygiB "DUF1190 family protein", tolC, nudF, yqiB "DUF1249 family protein", cpdA, yqiA "esterase YqiA", parE, ygiN "putative quinol monooxygenase", mdaB. named 60-98% (mean 91%), fewest named at column 15 (ygiC), named 60%; most hesitant at column 24 (mdaB), 0.24 bits.
8. column 25 fork: RGP 26%. named 91%; 0.40 bits.
   25: ygiZ S 75% "DUF2645 family protein"; also fitA S 27%
9. columns 26-29 (4 columns) spine: share 94-95%, all P, RGP 15-26%. Genes: qseC, qseB "response regulator", ygiW "OB fold stress tolerance protein Yg…", ygiV "GyrI-like domain-containing protein". named 93-96% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 29 (ygiV), named 93%, 0.31 bits.
10. columns 30-32 (3 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 5-14%. named 93-97% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 30, named 93%, 0.38 bits.
   30 fork: mqsR S 56% "type II toxin-antitoxin system toxi…"; also fitR S 27%
   31 variable: mqsA S 58%
   32 variable: ygiS S 82% "ABC transporter substrate-binding p…"
11. columns 33-59 (27 columns) spine: share 90-96%, all P, RGP 2-28%. Genes: parC, plsC, ftsP, ygiQ "YgiQ family radical SAM protein", yqhH "lipoprotein YqhH", yqhG "DUF3828 domain-containing protein", dkgA, yqhD, yqhC "DNA-binding transcriptional regulat…", yghB "DedA family protein", metC, exbB "tol-pal system-associated acyl-CoA…", exbD, yghA "NADP(+)-dependent aldehyde reductase", yqhA "TIGR00645 family protein", gpr, yghW "DUF2623 family protein YghW", hybO, hybA, hybB, hybC, hybD "HyaD/HybD family hydrogenase matura…", hybE, hypA, hybG, yghU "glutathione-dependent disulfide-bon…", gss. named 90-97% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 57 (hybG), named 90%; most hesitant at column 59 (gss), 0.52 bits.
12. columns 60-79 (20 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 54-86%. named 56-89% (mean 80%), fewest named at column 62, named 56%; most hesitant at column 61, 1.14 bits.
   a second branch of 5 families through columns 67-71, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10-13%, all P; the branch's families: speC, nupG, mltC, yggX, mutY
   a second branch of 3 families through columns 76-78, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10-12%, all S; the branch's families: pppA, gspS2, gspC
   60 variable: pitB P 75%
   61 fork: yghT S 76%; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 32%
   62 variable: yghS S 73% "dTMP kinase"
   63 fork: "hypothetical protein" S 71%; also yqgA P 14%
   64 fork: "hypothetical protein" S 66%; also yqgH S 13%
   65 variable: "hypothetical protein" S 63%
   66 variable: "YtfJ family protein" S 62%
   67 fork: lptF S 61%
   68 fork: lptG S 59% "LPS export ABC transporter permease…"
   69 fork: spt S 59%
   70 fork: "acyl carrier protein" S 59%
   71 fork: "NAD(P)-dependent oxidoreductase" S 57%
   72 variable: "fatty acyl-AMP ligase" S 52%
   73 variable: yghO S 57% "protein YghO"
   74 variable: glcC S 58%
   75 variable: glcD S 57% "glycolate oxidase subunit GlcD"
   76 fork: glcE S 54%
   77 fork: glcF S 52%
   78 fork: glcG S 49%
   79 fork: glcB S 42%; also glcA S 29%, sslE S 14%
